name: Faction Builder
description: Define a faction's purpose, power, resources, and conflict posture without writing canon. Field names are stable for future Canon mapping. This pack does not write canon, characters, locations, or factions. Workflow execution is not implemented.

stages.title: Identity
stages.intent: Name the faction and the story function it serves.

stages.title: Purpose
stages.intent: State the public mission and the private want.

stages.title: Power Base
stages.intent: Record who they command and who they fear.

stages.title: Resources
stages.intent: List money, force, information, sacred objects, or legitimacy.

stages.title: Internal Structure
stages.intent: Note ranks, fractures, and succession risk.

stages.title: Conflict Posture
stages.intent: How they start, escalate, or avoid fights.

stages.title: Canon Review
stages.intent: Human review. This pack does not write faction canon.
